title: Decoding an encoded hypothesis
statement: For a natural number $n$, let a sparse Fourier hypothesis consist of a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a rational coefficient assigned to each member. Encoding such a hypothesis as a bit list and then decoding that list returns the original hypothesis.
